title: Prof. Manish Kumar Goyal Appointed as Guest Professor at the University of Notre Dame, USA
excerpt: A proud moment for the Water Climate and Sustainability Lab, IIT Indore. This prestigious appointment reflects his continued commitment to excellence in research, innovation, and education, and will provide a platform to engage with distinguished faculty and researchers while fostering international collaboration.

title: Strengthening Capacities for Sustainable River Rejuvenation
excerpt: At the two-day Capacity Building Workshop on DPR Preparation & Betwa River Rejuvenation under the Namami Gange Programme (Bhopal), Prof. Goyal delivered a session on "Innovative Tools for Conservation, Rejuvenation and Decentralized Planning," covering GIS-based river basin planning, decentralized wastewater management, and nature-based solutions.

title: Mass Movement Hazard and Exposure in the Himalaya
excerpt: Published in Earth's Future (Wiley, AGU), this study traces rockfall, ice avalanche, and landslide trajectories across six mountain ranges spanning the Hindu Kush Karakoram Himalaya, one of the first regional-scale hazard and exposure assessments ever produced for the world's highest terrain. With Saket Dubey, Ashim Sattar, Simon Allen, Holger Frey, Umesh K. Haritashya, and Christian Huggel.

title: An Innovative Approach to Predict Atmospheric Rivers: Exploring Convolutional Autoencoder
excerpt: Published in Atmospheric Research (Apr 2023), this work trains a deep learning model on 8 years of global ERA5 reanalysis data to forecast atmospheric river behavior, scoring SSIM 0.739 / PSNR 64.42, roughly 4× better than a comparable ConvLSTM benchmark. With Shivam Singh.
